failing_gate.gate: hazard presence between 70% and 80% across selected source demonstrations
failing_gate.mechanism: The deficit is present in the sampler's own Bernoulli draw (0.6942 over 242 accepted theta draws), not introduced by planner rejection: of the 67 drawn-but-unwritten episodes, 48 (71.6%) were hazard-present, i.e. close to the overall rate, so the 49 IK rejections are approximately hazard-neutral. The realized rate is a low draw at roughly 2 sigma, not a configuration change.
failing_gate.why_not_remediable_within_constraints: Every level of aggregation - draws 0.6942, written 0.6857, successful 0.6909, selected 0.6900 - falls below the 0.70 floor required by the approved manifest. The gate is not met and cannot be met without either re-running the frozen collection and keeping the run whose hazard draw passes, or re-selecting the 100 episodes on the gated statistic. Both are forbidden by the task's no-tuning and no-silent-restart constraints.

next_recommended_task: Diagnose and re-approve the hazard-fraction gate before any retraining attempt. Either (a) amend the approved manifest so the accepted range reflects the sampler's realized rate under the frozen configuration - measured 0.6942 over 242 accepted theta draws, with 0.75 lying about 2 sigma above it - or (b) change ObstacleFumehoodPickSampler.OBSTACLE_P so the realized rate centres on 0.75, which is an environment change and therefore needs its own approval. Also fix the MolmoSpaces worker-loss defect: a house is buffered in memory and written only at house completion, so a hung worker silently discards its trajectories while the pipeline still exits 0 reporting 'skipped 0 houses'. Re-run the collection only under a re-approved manifest, as one new immutable collection ID.

summary: The frozen canonical collection ran to completion under the approved configuration but did not produce a dataset satisfying the manifest's hazard-distribution acceptance gate. Per the task's stop rule, conversion, training, bundling and live evaluation were not started.
